name: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)
when_to_use: Sequential/time-series data (e.g., climate humidity, stock price); continuous dependent variable; requires normalization (0-1) and formatting into a matrix by time steps.

expected_input.question: How to model nonlinear relationships with a simple neural network?

plain_explanation.purpose: Neural network that reads sequences keeping a memory of what it saw before.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When order matters: series over time or text.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Ordered sequences, such as values over time or words in a sentence.
plain_explanation.example: Predict the next value of a series from the last 30 days.
plain_explanation.diagram: step 1 -> step 2 -> step 3 (each passes memory to the next)
